what_happened.line: The commission agreed to gather map data on extending the Architectural Preservation District and to consult town counsel, after discussing a demolition delay at 763 Mass Ave.
The chair was directed to ask the municipal building design committee head and the planning board chair for formal commission representation.
The commission discussed solar panel review with no resolution, and the chair is to meet town counsel on solar, incentives and enforceability.
Members agreed to compile a list of historic-repair contractors and research incentives after discussing repairs at 50 Mass Ave.
The March 12 minutes are to be corrected for a missing phrase and sent to both clerk's office contacts; the next meeting is set for May 9.

why_it_matters: Extending the district boundary would bring more properties under demolition-delay and design review, which affects owners of older buildings in the area.
Formal seats on the municipal building design and master plan committees would give the commission a voice in town projects and planning, and no budget items were discussed.
